# orders-cli

Examples from release 1.2

## Install

    pip install orders-cli==1.3

## Reproduce an old run

    pip install orders-cli==1.2

argv:
cd /work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, tempfile, shutil
p='README.md'
with open(p,'rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
old=b'## Install\n\n    pip install orders-cli==1.2\n'
new=b'## Install\n\n    pip install orders-cli==1.3\n'
assert data.count(old)==1, data
out=data.replace(old,new)
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir='.', prefix='.README.md.')
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
    f.write(out)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
shutil.copymode(p,tmp)
os.replace(tmp,p)
EOF
cat -A README.md && echo '---' && cat README.md
cd /work && ls -la && echo '---' && tail -c 400 README.md | od -c | tail -20
cd /work && cat README.md && echo '===' && md5sum README.md
